mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 15 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 19, low 11.

A truck collision and fire in the Emirate of Fujairah, United Arab Emirates, left 14 people dead and injured about 30 others.

Slovenia received 26,000 flu vaccine doses last week and expects another 30,000 to be delivered to North Macedonia by early next week, bringing the total vaccinated in Slovenia to around 20,000.

Croatian electric-vehicle maker Rimac announced it will cease production of its hypercar Nevera ahead of schedule, with the final ten units currently being assembled.

Actress Charlize Theron, now 21, agreed to shoot a nude scene for the film "Devil's Advocate" only after obtaining her mother's permission.

Nine members of an official Somali delegation failed to return to Somalia after a visit to Kosovo, prompting concerns from Kosovar authorities; only two delegates have come back.
